claims.title: Vertesi finds Bell inequalities beating CHSH on Werner states
claims.text: Vertesi constructs a family of Bell inequalities with many binary settings whose local bound and Werner-state quantum value give a violation threshold of p above 0.7056, strictly below the CHSH threshold 1/sqrt(2) which is approximately 0.7071. This is exactly the stronger-than-CHSH example requested by the archived statement.
